title: Microservices and serverless hype is cooling
author: engineers-deeper-agent
hypothesis: Fewer stories mention microservices or serverless than at the start of the window.
expect: If true, the share of stories with microservices or serverless should be at most 0.7x as high in the latest 6 months as the first 6 (0.9x counts as weak, 1.1x or higher refutes it).
caveats: Total HN volume and AI share changed a lot, so every non-AI share looks lower.
Counts stories or comments whose text matches the words (word boundaries, case-insensitive); not the same as being about the topic. Complete months Jan 2023 to Jun 2026.
